channel.title: Middle East AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Israel/Gaza, Iran, Syria, Lebanon and Iraq developments

item.title: Netanyahu set for brief UNGA visit with limited diplomatic meetings, planned anti-Israel protests
item.description: The prime minister is expected to spend just six hours in the US, with no meeting planned with US President Donald Trump and protests expected to accompany his New York appearance.

item.title: Hamas 'ready' to move forward with Board of Peace ceasefire roadmap for Gaza, terror group says
item.description: Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qassem accused Israel of escalating aggression against Gazans, claiming that the Board of Peace and its director-general were unable to stop the Israeli government.

item.title: Israeli envoy to US's son fighting for life in hospital after car-ramming attack, Leiter says
item.description: Leiter said son Neria’s condition had stabilized, but stressed that his life was “still in danger” after Shaare Zedek Medical Center said he remained in serious condition following several surgeries.

item.title: Foreign Ministry urges Israeli travelers in Ecuador to exercise caution amid El Niño red alert
item.description: The Foreign Ministry advised Israelis in Ecuador to follow instructions from local authorities and avoid traveling through areas vulnerable to flooding, landslides, or strong water flows.

item.title: Expanding foothold in Israel, Ondas acquires three more defense tech companies
item.description: Ondas said the deal is intended to strengthen its “systems‑of‑systems” approach, combining sensing, connectivity, navigation, and autonomy across aerial and ground systems

item.title: Katz attacks 'paper sultan' Erdogan over UNGA speech, urges him to stop 'messing with Israel'
item.description: The defense minister accused Erdogan of financing and embracing Hamas, and claimed that he dreams of "restoring the Ottoman Empire" in a post on X/Twitter.

item.title: Becoming Israel’s Tuscany: Gov’t launches ‘Biblical Trail’ initiative to promote West Bank tourism
item.description: The NIS 3.2 million tourism project will include an accessible promenade and suspension bridge connecting the Eilon Moreh Heritage Center with the summit of the Mount Kabir Nature Reserve.

item.title: Iran receives Chinese intelligence, military-linked components to bolster drone program - report
item.description: According to WSJ, citing Iranian customs data, China has shipped around 1,300 shipments to Iran's defense ministry containing "dual-use" components and chemical compounds.

item.title: Gaza GenoLIE: The campaign fighting 'a modern blood libel'
item.description: A growing international coalition of more than 100 organizations says the accusation that Israel commits genocide in Gaza has become a weapon against Israel and Jews worldwide.

item.title: No. 1: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump: Remembering who brought the hostages home
item.description: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump helped achieve what few in Jerusalem thought possible, bringing every Israeli hostage home and reshaping the Middle East.

item.title: No. 3: Gadi Eisenkot: Israel’s next prime minister?
item.description: The former IDF chief has emerged as the leading opposition challenger to Netanyahu, offering voters a path to a post-Netanyahu Israel.

item.title: No. 4: Naftali Bennett: The former PM seeking a comeback to ‘repair Israel’
item.description: Since returning to politics, Bennett has shifted from his previous campaigns, taking a more liberal position while maintaining a strong right-wing stance on security.

item.title: No. 5: Ronald Lauder: Standing at the forefront of the fight against antisemitism
item.description: Lauder has never confined himself to quiet philanthropy - he continues to use his position to demand accountability from political leaders.

item.title: No. 2: Benjamin Netanyahu: Shaping Israel’s politics and global image for a generation
item.description: Netanyahu has become more than Israel’s prime minister for many. Abroad, for instance, he has become Israel’s symbol and the lightning rod for much of the hatred directed against the Jewish state.

item.title: Likud reevaluates strategy against Ofer Winter while shifting focus to turnout in loyal strongholds
item.description: As long as Likud continues trying to persuade Winter to withdraw, an agreement with him is not on the table. The party could still change its policy toward him through October 16.

item.title: IDF failed to defend Paga Outpost during Oct. 7, opening door for terrorists to massacre at Be'eri
item.description: The combat team posted at the outpost was not sufficiently prepared for such a terrorist infiltration, including not having conducted training drills or scenarios, the IDF probe found.

item.title: IDF reservist, son of Israeli envoy to US, seriously wounded in car-ramming terror attack
item.description: Neria Leiter underwent multi-hour brain surgery and remains in very serious condition, while his father, US Ambassador Yechiel Leiter, returned to Israel following the attack.

item.title: Macron's comments on Hamas's West Bank operations were mistranslated, French source tells 'Post'
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich denounced Macron's comments earlier on Wednesday, with Netanyahu calling the statements “outrageous.”

item.title: Pollster warns Likud that attacking Ofer Winter is a ‘very big gamble’ as party drops to 18 seats
item.description: "What has happened... since the candidate lists were submitted, is Ofer Winter, who is eating into the coalition bloc, eating into Likud and bringing it down to around 18 seats," pollster Lazar said.

item.title: The Quran is pro-Zionism. Here’s why – opinion
item.description: Islam’s holiest book contains elements that reinforce Jews’ right to the Land of Israel
